# Plan 02-01: Webview knob and meter

## Goal
A browser-openable UI with one knob and a level meter, bound to the plugin parameters.

## Context
`ui/` is a plain vite project. `ui/src/bridge.js` is the only place JS talks to C++.

## Tasks

<task id="1">
  <name>Knob component bound to drive</name>
  <files>ui/src/knob.js, ui/src/knob.css</files>
  <action>Pointer-drag knob writing to the bridge. Draw and hit-test must share one
  geometry source — do not compute the arc twice.</action>
  <verify>cd ui &amp;&amp; npm test</verify>
  <fails_when>non-zero exit, or "0 passing" in the test summary</fails_when>
  <done>Dragging the knob changes the drive parameter</done>

## Try it
`cd ui && npm run dev`, open http://localhost:5173, drag the knob.
